text: dsh-cool-ui 是面向 DSH Web 的机甲指挥舱视觉插件。它通过 bundle 同时接入 Host 和浏览器端：Host 为浏览器界面提供两张本地机甲背景图，浏览器端添加 HUD、背景、边框和响应式装饰。设置界面打开时会切换到另一张指挥舱场景，并针对深色与浅色外观调整配色。它适合希望改变 DSH Web 外观、增加科幻氛围但保留原有会话和工具交互的用户；使用时需在 Web profile 中安装插件，无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-cool-ui gives DSH Web a mecha command-interface look. The Host serves two bundled backgrounds; the browser adds a HUD, framing, and responsive styling, switching scenes in settings and adapting colors to light or dark appearance. It needs no API key or external service.
想给 DSH 网页版换成机甲指挥舱风格的界面
有没有能给 DSH Web 加 HUD 和科幻背景的主题？
I want a mecha-style visual theme for the DSH web interface.
dsh-cool-ui 的功能「机甲指挥舱外观」：在 DSH Web 页面叠加 HUD、背景图和装饰边框，并随设置界面切换场景、适配深浅外观；浏览器端加载时自动应用，卸载时清理添加的元素。

@dsh-cool-ui/plugin README · dsh-cool-ui：An original mecha-command visual layer for a DeepSeek Harness Web profile.

It is a single DSH bundle: the Host half serves the packaged hero artwork, and the browser half adds a non-interactive HUD, background treatment, and responsive framing without changing the Agent, session, or tool behavior.

@dsh-cool-ui/plugin README · Local development：```powershell
cd E:\code\dsh-cool-ui
pnpm install
pnpm build
cd E:\code\deepseek-harness

The bundle uses the public package name `@dsh-cool-ui/plugin`. Its `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one row that activates both the Host and browser halves.

@dsh-cool-ui/plugin README · Design source：`assets/mecha-hangar-hero.png` and `assets/mecha-settings-command-deck.png` are original generated artwork for this project. They are not anime screenshots, franchise assets, characters, logos, or promotional posters.

The visual direction uses common current mecha-key-art traits as abstract reference: dark structural hangars, cyan energy conduits, hard-surface mechanical detail, and sparse amber warnings.

@dsh-cool-ui/plugin README · Scope：This starter is a visual layer over the existing DSH Web shell. A full replacement of the sidebar, conversation layout, and routing would be a separate custom Web shell that still consumes the same DSH Host/API runtime.
